map.选择符合的情况（可多选）: Select the applicable conditions (multiple choices allowed)
map.反复种植失败(≥3次优质胚胎未孕): Repeated implantation failure (>=3 high-quality embryos without pregnancy)
map.女方高龄、反复种植失败、反复流产、严重男性因素: Advanced maternal age, repeated implantation failure, recurrent miscarriage, severe male factor
map.已知单基因病(致病基因明确)：地贫、血友病、囊性纤维化等: Known monogenic disease (clear pathogenic gene): thalassemia, hemophilia, cystic fibrosis, etc.
map.染色体结构异常：平衡易位、罗氏易位、倒位: Chromosomal structural abnormality: balanced translocation, Robertsonian translocation, inversion
map.：PGT-A 指征阈值常以 ≥38 岁为参考: : PGT-A indication threshold commonly referenced at >=38 years
map.：≥3 次优质胚胎移植未临床妊娠: : >=3 high-quality embryo transfers without clinical pregnancy
map.：夫妇一方染色体平衡易位/罗氏易位/倒位: : one partner with chromosomal balanced translocation / Robertsonian translocation / inversion
map.提示：PGT 不能完全替代产前诊断，妊娠后仍建议行绒毛/羊水穿刺确认。PGT-M: Tip: PGT cannot fully replace prenatal diagnosis; chorionic villus sampling / amniocentesis is still recommended after pregnancy. PGT-M requires haplotype construction of the family first. For learning reference only.
map.高龄/反复流产/染色体易位。: Advanced age / recurrent miscarriage / chromosomal translocation.
map.高龄(≥38)且 RPL≥2 次 → 符合 PGT-A 指征，建议行胚胎非整倍体: Advanced age (>=38) and RPL>=2 times: meets PGT-A indication; recommend embryonic aneuploidy screening.
map.染色体易位 → PGT-SR 指征，筛选正常/平衡胚胎降低流产。: Chromosomal translocation: PGT-SR indication; select normal / balanced embryos to reduce miscarriage.
map.PGT-A 非整倍体、PGT-M 单基因病、PGT-SR 结构重排，按指征选择。: PGT-A for aneuploidy, PGT-M for monogenic disease, PGT-SR for structural rearrangement; choose by indication.
map.仅当存在明确指征；需遗传咨询与伦理审批。: Only when clear indications exist; genetic counseling and ethics approval are required.
